name: ascii-zine-composition
description: Composes ASCII-accented interfaces and publication artifacts with legible hierarchy, truthful state, accessible ornament, and recoverable interactions. Applies when a zine or print-shop visual language should enrich an existing working surface.

contract.what: A restrained ASCII and typographic composition that helps a person read, act, and recover within an existing artifact.
when: A studio, workshop, explanatory page, or editable artifact calls for zine character and has an identified visitor task and receiving style owner.
boundaries: The receiving application owns meaning, state, data, permissions, and interaction. The selected visual contract owns palette and tokens. This method selects and integrates ornament; it leaves scientific encodings and operational status with their source owners.
contract.result: An expressive, source-owned composition with a complete semantic reading, recognizable controls, and focused evidence for the changed visitor behavior.

receivingUse.job: A studio, workshop, explanatory page, or editable artifact calls for zine character and has an identified visitor task and receiving style owner.
receivingUse.materialResult: An expressive, source-owned composition with a complete semantic reading, recognizable controls, and focused evidence for the changed visitor behavior.
receivingUse.completion: The receiving collaborator can locate the semantic source, work within its boundaries, and recognize the material result.

standing.evidenceMaturity: Repository-maintained portable contract with source-specific, revisable material-use evidence.
standing.wakeTrigger: Material use, human correction, receiving-artifact behavior, or independent evidence changes this route.

transferBoundary: This projection carries repository-local instruction yield. Current intent, repository evidence, and granted tool authority govern each activation.
